description: This file defines structures and functions for accessing SFNT name tables in font files, specifically for TrueType and OpenType fonts. It includes definitions for the FT_SfntName structure and functions to retrieve name count and specific name entries.

methods.name: FT_Get_Sfnt_Name_Count
methods.description: Retrieves the number of name strings in the SFNT 'name' table.

methods.name: FT_Get_Sfnt_Name
methods.description: Retrieves a specific name string from the SFNT 'name' table by index.
